evening.caption:
Season touched one ancient tree, and the whole forest rose with him 🌳

Season is the bright Yang spirit, and when he felt the strength in those old roots he became Yang Wood: the tall tree that grows straight up toward the light. Jia Wood doesn't wait or wind around obstacles. It stands upright, reaches higher every year and gives shade to everything growing beneath it. In people, it is the steady, principled, forward-looking side that takes the lead, keeps its word and lifts others as it climbs. Real strength grows slowly, from deep roots.

Who is the tall tree in your life, the one who stands firm so others can grow? Tag them below 👇
